title: mocon host record
description: core.md section 5.1. The capabilities declaration. Key (host, "host"). No id. A host MUST emit this before any other record for that host in every stream it opens.

host.description: Opaque string identifying the declaring host. Recommended form vendor/product[/profile].

unmediated_egress.description: Absent reads as unknown, which consumers treat like true.

attested.description: Entries from the list in provenance.md section 4, which grows by minor version (core.md section 8). Absent reads as []. This schema validates the shape (a string array), not membership in a specific version's list, so a 1.0 schema does not reject a future minor version's entries; a consumer ignores an entry it does not know. The 1.0 list is: crossing.target, crossing.input, crossing.output, crossing.error, execution.error.class.

ext.description: Open map of namespaced keys, vendor.key. Core consumers ignore it; relays preserve it.
